claims.evidence: The report shows only the exterior; mechanical condition is not shown.
The report states whether the engine starts and runs is not shown.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting, idling, and revving

risks.risk: Unknown year of manufacture or registration status
risks.proof: Photo of the VIN or chassis number and registration documents

risks.risk: No service, accident, or ownership history
risks.proof: Photos of service records and ownership documents

risks.risk: Worn brakes, chain, sprockets, battery, or electrical faults
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of brakes, chain, sprockets, battery, and all lights

risks.risk: Mechanical faults, leaks, or hidden damage
risks.proof: Video of the underside and engine while running, plus a leak inspection

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and idling
Photo of the VIN or chassis number and registration documents
Close-up photos of brakes, chain, sprockets, battery, and lights
Video of the motorcycle being ridden or rolled with brakes applied
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a motorcycle, so it can be priced at its worst case from the visible exterior; all mechanical claims are unproven.
